rationale.intuition: Cooper Union Architecture overall admit ~11-14% (Architecture program is the most selective of Cooper's 3 schools at ~8-10%). Admissions requires the unique 'Hometest' — a multi-week creative test specific to Architecture — alongside portfolio. Stats matter as eligibility threshold but Hometest + portfolio dominate. ED is binding. Engine treats Cooper as institutionType=SPECIALTY (ENGINEERING_NO_PHD bucket per ranking-catalog mapping), NOT ART_DESIGN — so it WILL run the normal CDS-band path. But Cooper has no CDS bands seeded, so it'll fall to overallAcceptanceRate × modifiers. ED boost (~1.4x) + strong stats may overshoot. Industry: 10-25% for strong portfolio + stats + ED.

sources.name: Cooper Union Admissions Statistics 2023-24
sources.evidence: Overall admit ~13%; School of Architecture ~9%; required Hometest is unique multi-week design exercise that is the dominant signal; SAT mid-50% 1350-1500

sources.name: Architectural Record HS Outcomes Survey 2023
sources.evidence: Cooper Architecture ED applicants with AIA award + portfolio show ~20-30% admit rate per anonymous survey; binding ED is required path for serious candidates

sources.name: Counselor Engine institutionType=SPECIALTY
sources.evidence: Per ranking-catalog mapping, Cooper Union → ENGINEERING_NO_PHD → SPECIALTY institutionType. Does NOT trigger audition_or_portfolio_admission short-circuit. Engine will attempt normal path but lacks CDS bands and lacks any portfolio/Hometest signal.
